design_warnings: This is a candidate TBox design report only, not approved ontology assertions, and it includes no named individuals.
All eight targets lacked exact-name matches, so all eight are CREATE. Air and reservation analogues are comparisons only; do not assert owl:equivalentClass.

Do not parent rail reservation information under https://example.org/ontologies/intel-ontology#reservation. That local class is asserted under material information bearer, while the prescribed parent AgentOntology/reservation is an information content entity.
Rail ticket is intentionally a material information bearer under ticket. A separate ticket information content entity is not proposed and must not be collapsed into rail_ticket.
Railway station is a building, parallel to airport. Platforms, tracks, and broader station sites may fall outside that genus.
Train is directly under BFO object because that is the prescribed parent, matching the coarse Airplane pattern. Do not invent an external vehicle IRI.
Rail passenger role is a BFO role borne by a person, not a subtype of person. Do not reuse Jetblue passenger or person, and do not change the prescribed direct parent to the loaded passenger role.
specifies_rail_journey links an information content entity to a process type at TBox level. A plan may exist when no journey has occurred; the range must not be read as requiring journey individuals.
departs_from_station, arrives_at_station, and occurs_aboard_train are not functional. Connected multi-leg journeys, train changes, and intermediate stops are unresolved and are not modeled here.

has_planned_departure_time belongs to the plan. Actual departure time is not represented. has_train_service_code is prescribed on the passenger train object, but service codes often identify scheduled services rather than a persistent material trainset.
Loaded has_departure_airport and has_arrival_airport are not reused. They are air-specific and appear in the data-property extract; the rail station relations are object properties.
Act of Flight Plan is a process and is not the analogue for rail journey plan. Flight plan, the information content entity, is the comparison.
Social-media classes, person-of-interest roles, terrorist-organization classifications, trip records, and statements about specific persons are out of scope and are not proposed.
Preserve slash versus hash in loaded CCO IRIs, including AgentOntology/building, AgentOntology/ticket, and AgentOntology/reservation. Do not normalize them into the local hash namespace.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and a railway station from which that journey departs.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and a train aboard which that journey occurs.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey plan and the rail journey specified by that plan.
